messages:
ava_sales: FYI prospect LumosPay asked for a 72h POC + security questionnaire. Key asks: SAML SSO, SCIM bulk (50k), RBAC with separate admin roles, domain ownership locking (DNS TXT), EU data residency, and Hosted vs Dedicated pricing. Need owners and a 1-page SOW + pricing blurb by EOD.
tom_se: thanks. Do they want Hosted first or Dedicated?
ava_sales: they prefer Hosted eval but want a costed path to Dedicated if perf is good. Procurement wants numbers.
meera_eng: quick sizing: for 50k SCIM and 100 TPS gen bursts recommend 4xGPU reserved for Dedicated with 1.5x burst; committed spend ballpark $30k-$70k/mo depending on model family and quantization. Hosted POC (72h, SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen) usually <$1k.
meera_eng: perf note: suggest quantized model variants and prefix KV caching to keep p95 latency low.
tom_se: SCIM details to confirm: do they need bulk create + PATCH deltas + group-sync? we'll send mapping example and recommend staged import. We can offer a temporary SCIM rate bump for the POC with backoff guidance.
sam_sec: security ask: request completed questionnaire, IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL, x509 cert), SCIM op scope (create/update/delete), data classification (PII/payment data), retention/audit windows, and whether HSM is required. We'll provide SOC2 link, DPA template, pen-test summary, and KMS/HSM options doc.
contracts: send legal contact and we'll prep DPA.
ava_sales: action items: (1) I'll ask LumosPay for IdP metadata + 100-user CSV sample + legal POC, (2) Meera to own perf smoke if needed, Tom to own integration and send SCIM mapping, Sam to upload security pack.
tom_se: SCIM mapping snippet ready to send. Also will provide SP metadata and ACS URLs after tenant creation.
meera_eng: POC plan draft: Day0 exchange metadata + tenant create; Day1 run 10k import + SSO checks; Day2 ramp imports to 50k, run perf smoke; Day3 handoff security logs and report. Can compress if they accept staged commit.
ava_sales: pricing blurb for procurement: "Hosted: pay-as-you-go, suitable for short evals; typical 72h POC (SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen) commonly < $1k. Dedicated: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and SLAs; for a 4-GPU cluster aimed at 100 TPS bursts expect committed spend in the ~$30k-$70k/month range depending on model family and quantization. One-time POC support can be covered via pilot credits or invoiced as PS."
sam_sec: uploaded security pack: https://redwood.internal/shared/lumospay-security.
ava_sales: submitted SOW draft and pricing to LumosPay procurement. They'll reply with IdP metadata and legal contact tomorrow. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
